description: This file defines an interface for a service related to managing family members of clients within the Fineract project. It declares methods for adding, updating, and deleting family members associated with a client.

classes.name: ClientFamilyMembersWritePlatformService
classes.description: Interface providing methods for managing family members of clients including adding, updating, and deleting family member records.

methods.name: addFamilyMember
methods.description: Adds a new family member to a client using their client ID and a command object.

methods.name: addClientFamilyMember
methods.description: Adds a new family member to a client object using a command object.

methods.name: updateFamilyMember
methods.description: Updates details of an existing family member identified by their family member ID.

methods.name: deleteFamilyMember
methods.description: Deletes a family member record identified by their family member ID.
